mapper.select: SELECT count(constract_state) FROM constract_info c join room_info r on c.room_id = r.room_id join building_info b on r.building_id = b.building_id WHERE b.imdaein_id = #{imdaeinId} AND c.constract_state = 1

SELECT count(payment_state) as payment_state, sum(m.payment_money) as payment_money FROM m_rent_payment_history m join room_info r on m.room_id = r.room_id join building_info b on r.building_id = b.building_id WHERE b.imdaein_id = #{imdaeinId} AND payment_state = -1
SELECT count(r.room_id) FROM room_info r join building_info b on r.building_id = b.building_id WHERE b.imdaein_id = #{imdaeinId}

SELECT count(*) FROM constract_info
WHERE TO_CHAR(exp_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,+3),'yyyy-MM-dd')

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM RN, a.* FROM ( SELECT m.POST_NO, m.TITLE, m.CONTENT, CASE WHEN m.ACCEPT_STATE = 0 THEN '접수전' WHEN m.ACCEPT_STATE = 1 THEN '접수중' WHEN m.ACCEPT_STATE = 2 THEN '처리 완료' END as ACCEPT_STATE, m.GROUP_ID, m.REG_DATE, m.MOD_DATE, r.ROOM_NO, r.BUILDING_ID, b.BUILDING_name FROM room_info r JOIN minwon m ON m.room_id = r.room_id JOIN building_info b ON b.building_id = r.building_id JOIN constract_info c ON m.room_id = c.room_id AND c.constract_state = 1 AND m.imchain_id = c.imchain_phone AND c.constract_state != -1 WHERE b.imdaein_id = #{imdaeinId} ORDER BY m.post_no DESC ) a )
WHERE ROWNUM<=10

WITH MonthlyRevenue AS ( SELECT b.building_id, b.building_name, TO_CHAR(p.payment_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS MONTH, SUM(NVL(p.real_payment_money, 0)) AS TOTAL_REVENUE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY TO_CHAR(p.payment_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY SUM(p.real_payment_money) DESC) AS RN FROM building_info b JOIN room_info r ON b.building_id = r.building_id JOIN constract_info c ON r.room_id = c.room_id JOIN m_rent_payment_history p ON c.constract_no = p.constract_no WHERE p.payment_date >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -3) AND TO_CHAR(p.payment_date, 'YYYY-MM') != TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM') GROUP BY b.building_id, b.building_name, TO_CHAR(p.payment_date, 'YYYY-MM') ) SELECT building_id, building_name, MONTH, TOTAL_REVENUE FROM MonthlyRevenue
WHERE RN <= 3
ORDER BY MONTH DESC, TOTAL_REVENUE DESC
